notes: The of in was spoken of is the English verb's own particle inside the participle's unit, while through answers to διά under rule 36.

Make ye ready is one support frame headed on ready under rule 17, whereas the second ποιεῖτε keeps a bare Make because εὐθείας has its own English word straight; the two are not the same construction and rule 2 splits the second.
ὁ / ῥηθείς splits under rule 32 with he on the article and that was spoken of on the participle, the ASV having written more than one English word for the pair, so rule 90 does not apply.
